components.name: EnvironmentBanner
components.behavior: Nonproduction environment context only; no secret/config value dump. Actual production hiding/build needs smoke proof.

components.name: Root shell and diagnostic routes
components.behavior: Existing route bytes preserved in P0-B normalization; current folder convention conflicts with App Router intent.

components.name: Button / Link / Focus
components.behavior: Semantic action/navigation, pending/disabled reason and visible focus; never authority.

components.name: Input / Select / FormField
components.behavior: Visible labels and accessible errors; owner validation remains server-side.

components.name: Dialog / AlertDialog
components.behavior: Keyboard focus containment/restoration and explicit consequences; no policy bypass.

components.name: Status / Result / AsyncProgress
components.behavior: Distinct denied/stale/partial/unknown/accepted/completed states; no generic success coercion.

components.name: Table / List / Pagination
components.behavior: Accessible header/empty/partial/cursor states; no total-count privacy leak.

components.name: ProtectedMediaView
components.behavior: Exact owner permission/proof/expiry, protected credential handling and current generation.

components.name: ActorContextSelector
components.behavior: Show selected permitted actor branch; switching context is not granting permission.

components.name: ConsentPresentation
components.behavior: Exact immutable content/version and explicit affirmative action; presentation is not proof.

components.name: SourceActionForm
components.behavior: Stable semantic intent, conflict/retry/reconcile, safe retained input; no double side effect.

components.name: AppShell / Navigation / Breadcrumbs
components.behavior: Role/current owner context drives available links; hidden navigation is not server access control.
